# Straand Hotel

> Straand Hotel is a historic, family-run hotel at Kviteseidvegen 1698, 3853 Vrådal, Telemark, Norway, on Lake Nisser. Founded 1864 as a coaching inn and run today by the fifth generation (Katrine and Lars Arne Straand). 125 rooms, restaurant and bars, heated indoor pool and sauna, a conference hall for 400, and the 1909 vintage boat MS Fram.

Contact: +47 35 06 90 00 (reception open 24 hours), straand@straand.no. Booking: https://be.synxis.com/?Hotel=7080. Check-in From 3 pm (4 pm June–September); check-out Before 11 am. Free parking (approx. 100 spaces) and EV charging. Legal entity: STRAAND HOTEL AS, org. no. 945 805 013. Each English page has a Norwegian (nb) twin.

## Business & conferences
- [Meetings and conferences in Telemark – for up to 600 people](https://straand.no/en/meetings-and-conferences/): The 660 m² Vrådal Hall seats 400 classroom-style and 600 theatre-style, with its own breakout rooms. Norwegian: https://straand.no/kurs-og-konferanse/
### Meetings and conferences
- [Leadership retreats](https://straand.no/en/meetings-and-conferences/leadership-retreats/): We have unique and intimate meeting places for your board meeting or leadership retreat!. Norwegian: https://straand.no/kurs-og-konferanse/ledersamling/
- [Straand Akademia](https://straand.no/en/meetings-and-conferences/straand-akademia/): We contribute to the success of the businesses of the future. Norwegian: https://straand.no/kurs-og-konferanse/straand-akademia/
- [Kick-off](https://straand.no/en/meetings-and-conferences/kick-off/): Bring the whole company together: a conference in the Vrådal Hall, dinner and a party in the evening, outdoor activities and rooms under one roof. Norwegian: https://straand.no/kurs-og-konferanse/kick-off/
- [Meeting rooms and equipment](https://straand.no/en/meetings-and-conferences/meeting-rooms-and-equipment/): The 660 m² Vrådal Hall, breakout rooms, stage, lighting and sound, break areas and easy access with a drive-in door straight into the hall. Norwegian: https://straand.no/kurs-og-konferanse/moterom-og-utstyr/

- [Summer parties](https://straand.no/en/meetings-and-conferences/summer-parties/): We invite you to a party both outside and inside our holiday paradise. Norwegian: https://straand.no/kurs-og-konferanse/sommerfest/

## Christmas
- Christmas parties 2026: 6 weekends, 2026-11-13 to 2026-11-15 (Quizgutta); 2026-11-20 to 2026-11-22 (AMCAR / Jan Heidenstrøm); 2026-11-27 to 2026-11-29 (Wallmans On Tour); 2026-12-04 to 2026-12-06 (Jørn Hoel); 2026-12-11 to 2026-12-13 (Stand-up); 2026-12-18 to 2026-12-20 (E-76). Party with show from NOK 850, with an overnight stay in a double room from NOK 1,920 per person.
